# Corpse Knight (M20). "Whenever another creature you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life."
# Event: Terror of the Peaks (B2b-other-enters-power-damage). Effect: Caged Zombie's
# "Each opponent loses N life" (LOSE_LIFE, controller ALL_OPPONENTS).
drain = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.LOSE_LIFE, {
        'amount': QConst(value=1),
        'controller': ControllerRef.ALL_OPPONENTS,
    }),
)
abilities = [drain, *compiled]
